content.title: Rain-City Chase Reframe | Cars, Dragon Reveal and Aerial Continuation
content.summary: A wet-city vehicle chase transfers its motion axis to one winged courier. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing all source-specific surfaces.

quick_start.input_format: One city geography and forward direction persist. + The winged subject remains the same after reveal. + The camera handoff is continuous and motivated. + No crash or destination is invented. + The final view preserves the original route below.
quick_start.recommended_input: Three courier vehicles race forward on one wet cyan-magenta service avenue. Transfer the forward axis from the vehicles to a close rear follow behind the same creature without a world reset. Ease wider behind the creature and end with its route extending over the same city; do not invent a destination or crash.
required_anchors: One city geography and forward direction persist.
The winged subject remains the same after reveal.
No crash or destination is invented.
The final view preserves the original route below.
usage_steps: Replace the example subject, setting, and surface details with an original concept.
Keep every required anchor and Creative DNA invariant causally visible.
Choose the MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 prompt and fill only the declared variable slots.
Check duration, event order, camera continuity, sound, and anti-copy constraints before generation.
applicable_scope: A wet-city vehicle chase transfers its motion axis to one winged courier. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing all source-specific surfaces.
Original 4–15 second concepts that can preserve every required anchor.
MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 projects that need a reusable causal video structure.
not_suitable_for: Requests that copy the source identity, setting, props, dialogue, or shot order.
Concepts that cannot show all required anchors inside the target duration.
Long-form exposition or unrelated multi-location stories without a compact causal chain.

creative_dna.mechanism: 先用雨夜赛博街道和多辆跑车建立高速前进轴，前方巨影升空后镜头抬升，追逐主体转为同一条红黑巨龙；摄影机持续从后跟随其穿过楼群，原有霓虹与城市方向保持连续。 The reusable mechanism preserves causal order, spatial anchors and the final proof while replacing every source-specific person, location, object, wording, choreography and design.

invariants.rule: One city geography and forward direction persist.
invariants.purpose: Establishes the baseline identity, object or geography that every later state must preserve.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact baseline rule, later changes cannot be attributed to the same subject, object or place, so the sequence loses its reference state. Removed rule: "One city geography and forward direction persist."

invariants.rule: The winged subject remains the same after reveal.
invariants.purpose: Makes the visible trigger precede and explain the first mechanism response.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact trigger rule, the response appears spontaneously and the central cause-and-effect claim is no longer demonstrated. Removed rule: "The winged subject remains the same after reveal."

invariants.rule: The camera handoff is continuous and motivated.
invariants.purpose: Keeps the middle progression registered instead of allowing an unexplained reset.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact progression rule, the middle can jump to a replacement state and the accumulated result is no longer traceable. Removed rule: "The camera handoff is continuous and motivated."

invariants.rule: No crash or destination is invented.
invariants.purpose: Reconnects the changed or partial state to the established subject and spatial anchor.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact reconnection rule, detail or transformed shots can belong to a different subject or geography and continuity cannot be verified. Removed rule: "No crash or destination is invented."

invariants.rule: The final view preserves the original route below.
invariants.purpose: Turns the terminal hold into observable proof that the mechanism completed.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact terminal-proof rule, the sequence stops on motion alone and never confirms the promised outcome or preserved aftermath. Removed rule: "The final view preserves the original route below."

slots.name: lead_subject
slots.constraint: An original stable subject or pair with a readable role.

slots.name: setting
slots.constraint: A new setting with fixed spatial anchors and no source-specific surface.

slots.name: escalation_variable
slots.constraint: One causal variable that changes through visible stages.

slots.name: performance_rule
slots.constraint: A restrained acting or motion rule that keeps the mechanism legible.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: An information order that proves each state without copying source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: A clean final physical, informational or social consequence.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of diegetic cues; no unsupported source-audio claim.

anti_copy_exclusions: all source faces, bodies, wardrobe, identities and creator-specific character designs
the source location, set dressing, props, products and exact environmental geometry
all source words, logos, watermarks, typefaces and brand identifiers
the source choreography, exact camera path, shot durations and transition timing
the source palette, signature effects, prompt wording, creator handle and narrative particulars
